description: AppConfig mutants for temporary-directory persistence, numeric normalization, and legacy migration contracts.

mutants.description: Lower the OpenGL FPS cap ceiling so a persisted value above 60 no longer resolves to the documented 240 maximum.
Resolve malformed plugin-page counts to the minimum rather than the documented default.
Collapse the plugin-page lower bound to the maximum, rejecting a negative persisted value as the documented minimum.
Drop the legacy physical-printer value while migrating it out of the extras section.
Invert empty-section cleanup so a migrated legacy extras section remains visible and a non-empty section can be erased.
